research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: ANYbotics is engaged in developing methods to reduce the risk of explosion of a battery for a mobile robot, focusing on battery housing, environmental sensors, and safety units. Additionally, they are researching a robot foot for legged robots, including a solid body with a surface and an attachment section for mounting. These activities highlight their focus on mobile robot safety and the mechanical design of legged robots.

overview_description.description: ANYbotics offers autonomous robotic inspection solutions for industrial operations. The company develops four-legged robots like ANYmal and ANYmal X that navigate complex, hazardous environments to perform data collection, routine inspection, and monitoring tasks. Their systems generate data insights to help identify issues such as leaks or equipment wear, and support decision-making around maintenance and safety. ANYbotics serves sectors including utilities, mining, chemicals, oil & gas, and transportation. The focus rests on reducing risk, improving operational consistency, and allowing inspections in areas difficult or unsafe for personnel.

about_short_description.short_description: ANYbotics is a robotics company that offers autonomous robotic inspection solutions for industrial operations.

product.name: ANYmal
product.description: An autonomous quadruped robot for industrial inspections, equipped with visual, thermal, acoustic, gas-detection, and 3D-scanning capabilities.

product.name: ANYmal X
product.description: A hazardous-area version of the ANYmal inspection robot for autonomous inspections in ATEX- and IECEx-rated industrial environments.

product.name: Workforce
product.description: An operator application for configuring, supervising, and reviewing autonomous ANYmal inspection missions from a tablet or other connected device.

product.name: Automated Robotic Inspection Solutions
product.description: End-to-end solutions that use autonomous ANYmal robots to collect inspection data, detect equipment anomalies, and support predictive maintenance.

product.name: ANYmal Onboarding and Integration Services
product.description: Deployment services covering use-case definition, ROI planning, operator training, facility mapping, mission setup, testing, integration, and ongoing operational support.

product.name: ANYmal Research Platform
product.description: An industrial-grade quadruped robotics platform for research in locomotion, navigation, perception, mapping, interaction, and mobile manipulation.
